description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeTerminationAPI. It contains unit tests for CRUD operations (delete, getOne, create, update) and validation rules related to employee termination records within the OrangeHRM system. It tests the API's behavior, including handling of errors like record not found and validation rules, by mocking dependent services and data.
